[\+ $74.99/mo Program Fee](https://www.ivimhealth.com/glp1idwt/#comparison-table)
Our intake questionnaire and consultation with a provider determine if you medically qualify.

Upon cancellation, we will refund any unshipped medication, less an administrative/restocking fee of $100 for each undeveloped three-month portion of your plan or $50 for each undeveloped two-month portion (as applies to four- or six-month programs). For example, ending a six-month plan after three months’ shipments would trigger one $100 fee; cancelling a six-month plan after two months would incur two $50 fees for the remaining four months’ supply. This fee will be waived entirely if a provider determines you are medically ineligible to continue; for instance, due to pregnancy or other documented contraindications.

page_copy.title: Ivim Health review: pricing, eligibility and cancellation
page_copy.description: Reported provider information with unsupported costs and clinical claims left unknown.
page_copy.affiliate_disclosure: Clinic Scout is an independent comparison publisher, not a clinic. We may earn a commission if you use a provider link. Compensation does not establish treatment suitability.
page_copy.bottom_line: Compare the selected plan’s complete costs and terms before considering enrollment. A provider’s marketing statements and affiliate approval do not establish medical suitability or independent quality verification.
page_copy.pricing: Reported information: Ivim’s retained sources describe medication starting figures and a separate program fee. Neither establishes the complete selected first payment or renewal bill. This draft does not treat a medication-only headline as an all-inclusive monthly cost.
page_copy.eligibility: Reported information: Ivim says its intake questionnaire and provider consultation determine medical qualification. This is a care-process description, not a promise of approval or treatment effectiveness. Independent clinical and claim acceptance remains pending.
page_copy.cancellation: Reported information: Ivim describes conditional refunds for unshipped medication and plan-dependent administrative/restocking fees. The retained terms contain specific exceptions and examples. This draft makes no “cancel anytime for a full refund” promise; the selected-plan terms must control.
page_copy.clinical_boundary: This is research-based information, not first-hand treatment experience or medical advice. Any prescription requires individual clinician assessment. No efficacy, safety, certification or guaranteed outcome claim is approved by this draft.
